definitions.full: H5121. Navith נוית Kt (i.e. נָוִית , or נָָֽוְיַת , Ginsb), נָיוֺת Qr; probably proper name, of a location in Ramah (possibly = habitations , but dubious, see Dr 1Sam 19:18 HPS); — adode of prophets 19:18-19 , 22 , 23 (twice in verse) and 20:1 (where Baer נוות Kt); followed by בָּרָמָה (except 19:18 ); ᵐ5 Ἀυαθ ( ν dropped out after ἐν ), so ᵐ5 L A Ναυιωθ .
